p=Path('programs/task-17f5503a.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Reflect colored figures across the horizontal separator lines in each cell.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The separator color is the unique full horizontal/vertical line color.
    sep=next(v for v in set(sum(grid,[])) if sum(1 for r in grid if all(x==v for x in r))>0)
    bars=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==sep for x in grid[r])]
    # Reflect each colored shape to the other side of its horizontal divider.
    for i in range(len(bars)-1):
        top,bottom=bars[i],bars[i+1]
        mid=(top+bottom)//2
        for r in range(top+1,bottom):
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[r][c] not in (0,sep):
                    rr=2*mid-r
                    if top < rr < bottom and grid[rr][c]==0:
                        out[rr][c]=grid[r][c]
    return out
''')
